payload.query: SELECT mupolygonkey,mukey,mupolygongeo.STIsValid() AS native_valid,mupolygongeo.STArea() AS native_coordinate_area,mupolygongeo.STAsText() AS source_wkt,CONVERT(varchar(max),mupolygongeo.STAsBinary(),2) AS source_wkb,mupolygonproj.STAsText() AS wm_wkt FROM mupolygon WHERE mupolygonkey IN (363859326,363864542,364049010,364075555,364075709,364075751,364095557) ORDER BY mupolygonkey
